verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM runs entirely on the user's computer, and its docs say no data leaves the device. A developer also confirmed that defaults are private/local and that any external LLM, embedder or vector DB is opt-in per component. This keeps user data out of third-party model training by design. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or policy that user data is never used for training, documentation of training-data handling when cloud models or the hosted offering are used, and independent verification that no data leaves the device.
